lineage.description: IPC acute food insecurity phase classifications were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule and spatially attributed to administrative units in El Salvador. The medium-term projection scenario for January 2022 was encoded as GeoJSON and KML geographic data, with each unit assigned an IPC phase value reflecting projected food security conditions driven primarily by drought and livelihood stressors.
